text: Meeting that takes place as needed, in addition to the general meetings, is extraordinary as per the bylaws. The resolutions are related to the unusual business of the company, for example, approval of takeovers or mergers or spin-offs. These meetings are always issuer initiated.

Includes annual and ordinary meetings. Statutory meeting(s) usually held at least once a year. The resolutions are related to the usual business of the company, for example, approval of dividends and directors. These meetings are always issuer initiated.
Meeting which contains both ordinary and extraordinary resolutions.
Meeting that takes place as needed that is neither ordinary nor extraordinary.
Physical meeting of bond holders.
Meeting is the result of a legal proceeding.
Meeting held periodically to approve the financial statements and to elect the board members and the auditors.
Meeting for holders of a specific type of asset, for example, preferred shares, bonds.
Meeting is the result of an obligation or a decision made by the issuer as opposed to voting rights holder initiated, for example, contested meeting.
Meeting which is planned in the by-laws.
Meeting is the result of a request or an action of a voting right holder(s), for example, contested meeting.
Number assigned by a government agency to identify foreign nationals.
Number assigned by an issuer to identify a customer via the concatenation of the birthdate and characters of the first name and surname.
Number assigned to a corporate entity.
Number assigned to a driver's license.
Number assigned by a national authority to an identity card.
National registration identification number. In Singapore this is known as the NRIC.
Number assigned by a passport authority.
Number assigned by a social security agency.
Number assigned by a tax authority to an entity.
Balance of securities that are blocked or frozen. A financial instrument may be unavailable due to external circumstances such as a court order, death of beneficiary or account owner, or bankruptcy.
Total number of securities eligible for this event.
Balance of securities that are pending delivery.
Balance of securities that are pending receipt.
Balance of securities that are registered (in the name of a nominee or of the beneficial owner).
Balance of securities representing only settled transactions.
Balance of securities that have been borrowed from another party.
Balance of securities that have been loaned to a third party.
Balance of securities that remain registered in the name of the prior beneficial owner of securities.
Balance of securities representing traded transactions.
Balance of securities that belong to a third party and that are held for the purpose of collateralisation.
Balance of securities that belong to the safekeeping account indicated within this message, and are deposited with a third party for the purpose of collateralisation.
Balance of uninstructed position.
Balance of instructed position.
Balance of securities currently being processed by the institution responsible for registering the new beneficial owner (or nominee) of securities after a transaction has settled.
Cancellation due to insufficient participation to the vote.
Cancellation due to a processing error.
Cancellation due to the meeting being cancelled by the issuer.
